draft.shortGloss: to look at; to check; to look after
draft.emotion: focused and alert, shifting attention toward something that caught the eye
notes: Can be used directly ('olhar algo') or with the preposition 'para' ('olhar para algo').
Use 'olhar' for directing your eyes intentionally, and 'ver' for seeing in general or watching TV/movies. For 'to look for', use 'procurar'.
